reliability.rationale: All saved predictions and primary metrics independently reproduce from source-verified inputs, including unfavorable alternatives. A development-simplified five-parameter startup/pilot scaling improves log-runtime MAE on five circuit families. It needs measured Qiskit pilot runtime; absolute runtime MAE5.1900s is worse than proportional-domain2.1163s, and two attempted SDK floors were unidentifiable. No universal compiler-complexity law or absolute-time benefit is certified.
